stem: Which statement best describes how a clinician should choose a fluoride type and treatment modality for a pediatric patient?

options.text: Select systemic or topical products, in the office or at home, based on the individual patient's specific needs.
Use one standard fluoride product and setting for every patient, whatever their individual needs.
Base supplement recommendations on age alone, without regard to the water fluoride level.
Avoid fluoride for caries prevention because it has not been shown to be safe and effective.
Limit fluoride therapy to professionally applied agents, since home-use products fall outside fluoride therapy.
